name: Bag BOM
description: Offline webcam label scanning and component selection for InteractiveHtmlBom.
description_full: Show a component bag label to your webcam and highlight exact MPN or supplier-number matches in an existing InteractiveHtmlBom export. OCR runs locally in the browser with bundled assets. Ambiguous matches require manual selection. Experimental release; requires InteractiveHtmlBom separately. Apache-2.0.
